title: 協助查明選字偶爾失敗的原因
summary: 新增預設關閉的本機選字診斷，區分原生讀取、焦點驗證與相容複製失敗。
highlights: 診斷只記錄階段與控制項類型，不記錄選取文字或剪貼簿內容。
保留既有選字安全檢查，避免為排查問題而放寬讀取限制。
usage: 排查問題時，先正常結束 SnapBar，再以環境變數 SNAPBAR_SELECTION_DIAGNOSTICS=1 啟動。紀錄位於本機 AppData/Local/SnapBar/diagnostics。結束程式並移除環境變數後重新啟動即可關閉；一般使用不需開啟。

en.title: Investigate intermittent selection failures
en.summary: Optional local diagnostics distinguish native reads, focus validation and compatibility copy failures.
highlights: Records stages and control types without selected text or clipboard contents.
Preserves existing selection safety checks during troubleshooting.
en.usage: Quit SnapBar normally, then launch with SNAPBAR_SELECTION_DIAGNOSTICS=1. Logs are stored under local AppData/Local/SnapBar/diagnostics. Quit, remove the variable and restart to disable diagnostics. Normal use does not require this mode.
